🆕 New (Published: September 30, 2026)

The city conducts cultural property fire drills each year with community cooperation to protect heritage buildings and structures from fire and other disasters. This year's drill will take place at Jōrakuin (Takayama Fudō).

Date and Time

Sunday, October 25, 2026 (Reiwa 8), starting at 2:00 p.m., lasting approximately one hour

Location

Jōrakuin (346 Takayama)

Notes

From 1:50 p.m. on the day of the drill until the drill ends, surrounding roads will be temporarily closed to traffic. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kyoikubu/hakubutsukan/bunkazaitanto/bunkazai/14146.html
summary: ℹ️ Cultural Property Fire Drill to be held on October 25, 2026 (Reiwa 8)
